C0359.title: Door-Gap Squeezing and Password Guessing: Gongshu Police Crack Theft Case
C0359.summary: A thief in Hangzhou's Gongshu District first broke into a warehouse by squeezing through a door gap. After the owner upgraded to a combination lock, the thief successfully cracked the code through repeated trial and error and stole again. Police eventually apprehended the suspect and recovered the stolen items.
